calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) n_receipt_lines,
 sum(f.quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_rows, min(f.sale_date) mind, max(f.sale_date) maxd,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

(1 row)

calls.statement:
SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n, sum(f.quantity) units, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) ids, max(f.etl_loaded_at) loaded
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.quantity) units, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(f.net_amount) net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=107 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.business_date, r.receipts, f.receipts fr, r.units_sold, f.units, r.net_sales_before_returns, f.net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r FULL JOIN f ON f.sale_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=107 AND r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
AND (r.units_sold IS DISTINCT FROM f.units OR r.receipts IS DISTINCT FROM f.receipts OR r.net_sales_before_returns IS DISTINCT FROM f.net)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) returned_units_in_period_for_cleaning, count(*) n
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
